component.name: Sens
component.description: The cutting-edge GNP Sens design elevates radar technology to meet or exceed the specifications used by most military organizations operating today.

component.name: Cryo-Star SL
component.description: J-Span’s done it again. The Cryo-Star SL incorporates the same consumer award winning performance and durability you’ve come to expect from a Cryo-Star, but now available for smaller vehicles.

component.name: Castra
component.description: When performance meets price for vehicle shield generators, the Castra is the clear winner. It has been a Whitley’s Guide “Best Buy” for five consecutive years.

component.name: Turret
component.description: Multitask on the battlefield with this remote turret system. Featuring precise controls and a wide field of fire, the turret allows pilots to add combat support to their resume.

component.name: VariPuck S2 Gimbal Mount
component.description: The VariPuck fits between your weapon and the ship hardpoint to transform a fixed weapon mount into a gimballed mount, allowing the pilot to independently aim their weapon’s fire. VariPucks will accept any weapon the same size as the hardpoint it is mounting to.

component.name: Scorpion GT-215 Gatling
component.description: The Scorpion GT-215 is a hydraulically-driven Gatling-type rotary cannon designed to deliver smaller rounds at a very high rate of fire. The Scorpion is designed to shred armor on very fast targets, sacrificing power for absolute saturation of the target area.

component.name: Defiant
component.description: In this cutthroat universe, the competition doesn’t stop when you do. That’s why you need the Defiant industrial power plant equipped in your vehicle. It’s optimized by the experts at Juno Starwerk to provide unmatched performance compared to other components in its class.
